name: Goblins Wood
storyline: Dive into a fantasy world where mischievous goblins run their own lumber empire. Combine, evolve, and manage goblin workers in this addicting idle tycoon simulator. Ready to become the richest goblin overlord?
summary: Are you ready for a new mining simulator game - Goblins Wood: Tycoon Idle Sim? Join this exciting idle merge adventure and enjoy a lot of challenging levels!
